resources.string:
UnsendVault can contact GitHub (api.github.com) at most once a day while you use the app to see if a newer version exists.

GitHub sees your IP address and the app version, like any website visit. Nothing from your archive is ever sent.

You can change this at any time in Settings.

Download opens the APK in your browser; you install it yourself. The release page lists its SHA-256 checksum and signing certificate so you can verify the file, and Android only installs it over this app if it is signed with the same key.
